verses.en: And these are the kings of the country which Yahoshua and the children of Yisra'el smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Yahoshua gave unto the tribes of Yisra'el for a possession according to their divisions;
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ በምዕራብ በኩል በሊባኖስ ሸለቆ ካለችው ከበኣልጋድ ወደ ሴይር እስከሚያወጣው ወና እስከ ሆነው ተራራ ድረስ ኢያሱ በየክፍላቸው ርስት አድርጎ ለእስራኤል ነገድ በሰጣት ምድር፥ በተራራማው አገር፥ በቈላውም፥ በዓረባም፥ በቍልቍለቱም፥ በምድረ በዳውም፥ በደቡቡም ያሉ ኬጢያውያን አሞራውያንም ከነዓናውያንም ፌርዛውያንም ኤዊያውያንም ኢያቡሳውያንም የሆኑ ኢያሱና የእስራኤል ልጆች የመቱአቸው የምድር ነገሥታት እነዚህ ናቸው፤

verses.en: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ በምዕራብ በኩል በሊባኖስ ሸለቆ ካለችው ከበኣልጋድ ወደ ሴይር እስከሚያወጣው ወና እስከ ሆነው ተራራ ድረስ ኢያሱ በየክፍላቸው ርስት አድርጎ ለእስራኤል ነገድ በሰጣት ምድር፥ በተራራማው አገር፥ በቈላውም፥ በዓረባም፥ በቍልቍለቱም፥ በምድረ በዳውም፥ በደቡቡም ያሉ ኬጢያውያን አሞራውያንም ከነዓናውያንም ፌርዛውያንም ኤዊያውያንም ኢያቡሳውያንም የሆኑ ኢያሱና የእስራኤል ልጆች የመቱአቸው የምድር ነገሥታት እነዚህ ናቸው፤

verses.en: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
verses.am: የኢያሪኮ ንጉሥ፥ በቤቴል አጠገብ ያለችው የጋይ ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Yerushalayim, one; the king of Hebron, one;
verses.am: የኢየሩሳሌም ንጉሥ፥ የኬብሮን ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
verses.am: የየርሙት ንጉሥ፥ የለኪሶ ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
verses.am: የጌድር ንጉሥ፥ የሔርማ ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
verses.am: የጌድር ንጉሥ፥ የሔርማ ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
verses.am: የዓራድ ንጉሥ፥ የልብና ንጉሥ፥ የዓዶላም ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
verses.am: የመቄዳ ንጉሥ፥ የቤቴል ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
verses.am: የለሸሮን ንጉሥ፥ የማዶን ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
verses.am: የለሸሮን ንጉሥ፥ የማዶን ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
verses.am: የአሶር ንጉሥ፥ የሺምሮን ሚሮን ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
verses.am: የአዚፍ ንጉሥ፥ የታዕናክ ንጉሥ፥ የመጊዶ ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Shimronmeron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
verses.am: የቃዴስ ንጉሥ፥ በቀርሜሎስ የነበረ የዮቅንዓም ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
verses.am: በዶር ኮረብታ የነበረ የዶር ንጉሥ፥ የጌልገላ አሕዛብ ንጉሥ፥

verses.en: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;
verses.am: የቲርሳ ንጉሥ፥ ነገሥታቱ ሁሉ ሠላሳ አንድ ናቸው። a

verses.en: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.
Now Yahoshua was old and stricken in years; and YAHUAH said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ሸመገለ በዕድሜም አረጀ፤ እግዚአብሔርም አለው። አንተ ሸመገልህ፥ በዕድሜህም አረጀህ፤ ያልተወረሰች እጅግ ብዙ ምድር ገና ቀርታለች፤

verses.en: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,
verses.am: የቀረችውም ምድር ይህች ናት፥ የፍልስጥኤማውያንና የጌሹራውያን አገር ሁሉ፥

verses.en: From Sihor, which is before Mitsrayim, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:
verses.am: በግብፅ ፊት ካለው ከሺሖር ወንዝ ጀምሮ በሰሜን በኩል እስካለችው የከነዓናውያን ሆና እስከ ተቈጠረችው እስከ አቃሮን ዳርቻ ድረስ፥ የጋዛ፥ የአዛጦን፥ የአስቀሎና፥ የጌት፥ የአቃሮን፥ አምስቱ የፍልስጥኤማውያን መኳንንት፥

verses.en: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:
verses.am: በደቡብም በኩል የኤዋውያን፥ የከነዓናውያን ምድር ሁሉ፥ ለሲዶናውያንም የምትሆን መዓራ እስከ አሞራውያን ዳርቻ እስከ አፌቅ ድረስ፥

verses.en: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baalgad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.
verses.am: የጌባላውያውንም ምድር፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል ከአርሞንዔም ተራራ በታች ካለችው በኣልጋድ ጀምሮ እስከ ሐማት መግቢያ ድረስ ያለችው ሊባኖስ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephothmaim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Yisra'el: only divide thou it by lot unto the Yisra'elites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
verses.am: በተራራማውም አገር የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ ከሊባኖስ ጀምሮ እስከ ማሴሮን ድረስ ሲዶናውያን ሁሉ፤ እነዚህን ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት አባርራቸዋለሁ፤ እንዳዘዝሁህም ምድራቸውን ለእስራኤል ርስት አድርገህ አካፍላቸው።

verses.en: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
verses.am: አሁንም ይህን ምድር ለዘጠኙ ነገድ ለምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ርስት አድርገህ ክፈለው።

verses.en: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Mosheh gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH gave them;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ እንደ ሰጣቸው ከእርሱ ከምናሴ ጋር የሮቤልና የጋድ ልጆች በምሥራቅ በኩል በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ሙሴ የሰጣቸውን ርስታቸውን ተቀበሉ።

verses.en: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
verses.am: በአርኖን ሸለቆ ዳር ካለችው ከአሮዔር፥ በሸለቆውም መካከል ካለችው ከተማ ጀምሮ የሜድባን ሜዳ ሁሉ እስከ ዲቦን ድረስ፥

verses.en: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.am: በሐሴቦንም የነገሠ የአሞራውያን ንጉሥ የሴዎን ከተሞች ሁሉ እስከ አሞን ልጆች ዳርቻ ድረስ፥

verses.en: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
verses.am: ገለዓድንም፥ የጌሹራውያንንና የማዕካታውያንን ዳርቻ ሁሉ፥ የአርሞንዔምንም ተራራ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Mosheh smite, and cast them out.
verses.am: ባሳንንም ሁሉ እስከ ሰልካ ድረስ፥ በባሳን የነበረውን በአስታሮትና በኤድራይ የነገሠውን የዐግን መንግሥት ሁሉ፤ እርሱም ከራፋይም የቀረ ነበረ፤ እነዚህንም ሙሴ መታቸው አወጣቸውም።

verses.en: Nevertheless the children of Yisra'el expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Yisra'elites until this day.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ግን ጌሹራውያንንና ማዕካታውያንን አላወጡም፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ጌሹርና ማዕካት በእስራኤል መካከል ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of YAHUAH of Yisra'el made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.am: ለሌዊ ነገድ ግን ርስት አልሰጠም፤ ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር የቀረበው በእሳት የተደረገ መሥዋዕት ርስታቸው ነው፥ እርሱ እንደ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: And Mosheh gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለሮቤል ልጆች ነገድ በየወገናቸው ርስትን ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም በአርኖን ሸለቆ ዳር ካለችው ከአሮዔር ጀምሮ በሸለቆው መካከል ያለችው ከተማ፥ የሜድባ ሜዳ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamothbaal, and Bethbaalmeon,
verses.am: ሐሴቦንም፥ በሜዳውም ያሉት ከተሞችዋ ሁሉ፥ ዲቦን፥ ባሞትበኣል፥

verses.en: And Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
verses.am: ቤትበኣልምዖን፥ ያሀጽ፥ ቅዴሞት፥

verses.en: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mount of the valley,
verses.am: ሜፍዓት፥ ቂርያታይም፥ ሴባማ፥ በሸለቆውም ተራራ ያለችው ጼሬትሻሐር፥

verses.en: And Bethpeor, and Ashdothpisgah, and Bethjeshimoth,
verses.am: ቤተ ፌጎር፥ ከፈስጋ ተራራ በታች ያለው ምድር፥ ቤትየሺሞት፥

verses.en: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Mosheh smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
verses.am: የሜዳውም ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ በሐሴቦንም የነገሠው የአሞራውያን ንጉሥ የሴዎን መንግሥት ሁሉ ነበረ፤ ሙሴም እርሱንና በምድሪቱ የተቀመጡትን የሴዎንን መሳፍንት፥ የምድያምን አለቆች ኤዊን፥ ሮቆምን፥ ሱርን፥ ሑርን፥ ሪባን መታቸው።

verses.en: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Yisra'el slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
verses.am: ከገደሉአቸውም ሰዎች ጋር የእስራኤል ልጆች ምዋርተኛውን የቢዖርን ልጅ በለዓምን በሰይፍ ገደሉት።

verses.en: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
verses.am: የሮቤልም ልጆች ድንበር የዮርዳኖስ ወንዝና ዳርቻው ነበረ። የሮቤል ልጆች ርስት ከተሞቻቸውም መንደሮቻቸውም በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Mosheh gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለጋድ ነገድ ለጋድም ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው ርስት አድርጎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም ኢያዜርና የገለዓድ ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ የአሞንም ልጆች ምድር እኩሌታ በረባት ፊት እስካለችው እስከ አሮዔር ድረስ፥

verses.en: And from Heshbon unto Ramathmizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
verses.am: ከሐሴቦን ጀምሮ እስከ ራማት ምጽጴ፥ እስከ ብጦኒም ድረስ፥ ከመሃናይም ጀምሮ እስከ ዳቤር ዳርቻ ድረስ፥

verses.en: And in the valley, Betharam, and Bethnimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
verses.am: በሸለቆውም ቤትሀራም፥ ቤትኒምራ፥ ሱኮት፥ ጻፎን፥ የሐሴቦን ንጉሥ የሴዎን መንግሥት ቅሬታ ነበረ። ድንበሩም ዮርዳኖስና በምሥራቅ በኩል ባለው በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ የኪኔሬት ባሕር ወዲያኛው ዳርቻ ነበር።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
verses.am: የጋድ ልጆች ርስት ከተሞቻቸውም መንደሮቻቸውም በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Mosheh gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ ርስት ሰጣቸው፤ ለምናሴም ልጆች ነገድ እኩሌታ በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም ከመሃናይም ጀምሮ የባሳን ንጉሥ የዐግ መንግሥት፥ ባሳን ሁሉ፥ በባሳንም ያሉት የኢያዕር መንደሮች ሁሉ ስድሳው ከተሞች፥ የገለዓድም እኩሌታ፥

verses.en: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
verses.am: በባሳንም ያሉት የዐግ መንግሥት ከተሞች፥ አስታሮትና ኤድራይ ነበረ። እነዚህም ለምናሴ ልጅ ለማኪር ልጆች ሆኑ፤ ለማኪር ልጆች እኩሌታ በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: These are the countries which Mosheh did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
verses.am: ሙሴ በምሥራቅ በኩል በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በሞዓብ ሜዳ ሳለ የከፈለው ርስት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: But unto the tribe of Levi Mosheh gave not any inheritance: YAHUAH of Yisra'el was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.am: ለሌዊ ነገድ ግን ሙሴ ርስት አልሰጠም፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዳላቸው ርስታቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: And these are the countries which the children of Yisra'el inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Yahoshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Yisra'el, distributed for inheritance to them.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በከነዓን ምድር የወረሱት፥ ካህኑ አልዓዛርና የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ነገድ የአባቶቻቸው አለቆች ያካፈሉአቸው ርስት ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: By lot was their inheritance, as YAHUAH commanded by the hand of Mosheh, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ ለዘጠኙ ነገድና ለእኩሌታው በየርስታቸው በዕጣ አካፈሉአቸው።

verses.en: For Mosheh had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.
verses.am: ለሁለቱ ነገድና ለእኩሌታው ነገድ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ሙሴ ርስት ሰጥቶ ነበረ፤ ነገር ግን በመካከላቸው ለሌዋውያን ርስት አልሰጣቸውም።

verses.en: For the children of Yoseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.
verses.am: የዮሴፍ ልጆች ምናሴና ኤፍሬም ሁለት ነገዶች ነበሩ፤ ለሌዋውያንም ከሚቀመጡባቸው ከተሞች ለእንስሶቻቸውና ለከብቶቻቸውም ከሚሆን መሰምርያቸው በቀር በምድሩ ውስጥ ድርሻ አልሰጡአቸውም።

verses.en: As YAHUAH commanded Mosheh, so the children of Yisra'el did, and they divided the land.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ልጆች አደረጉ፥ ምድሪቱንም ተካፈሉ።

verses.en: Then the children of Yehudah came unto Yahoshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that YAHUAH said unto Mosheh the man of YAHUAH concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ልጆች በጌልገላ ወደ ኢያሱ ቀረቡ፤ ቄኔዛዊውም የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ አለው። ለአምላክህ ሰው ለሙሴ ስለ እኔና ስለ አንተ እግዚአብሔር በቃዴስ በርኔ የተናገረውን ነገር ታውቃለህ።

verses.en: Forty years old was I when Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH sent me from Kadeshbarnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ ምድርን እሰልል ዘንድ ከቃዴስ በርኔ በላከኝ ጊዜ እኔ የአርባ ዓመት ሰው ነበርሁ እኔም በልቤ የነበረውን ቃል መለስሁለት።

verses.en: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed YAHUAH my YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር የወጡ ወንድሞቼ ግን የሕዝቡን ልብ አቀለጡ፤ እኔ ግን አምላኬን እግዚአብሔርን ፈጽሜ ተከተልሁ።

verses.en: And Mosheh sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children's for ever, because thou hast wholly followed YAHUAH my YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሙሴም በዚያ ቀን። አምላኬን እግዚአብሔርን ፈጽመህ ተከትለሃልና እግርህ የረገጠው ምድር ለአንተና ለልጆችህ ለዘላለም በእርግጥ ርስት ይሆናል ብሎ ማለ።

verses.en: And now, behold, YAHUAH hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since YAHUAH spake this word unto Mosheh, while the children of Yisra'el wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለሙሴ ይህን ቃል ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ እስራኤል በምድረ በዳ ሲዞሩ፥ እርሱ እንደ ተናገረኝ እግዚአብሔር እነዚህን አርባ አምስት ዓመት በሕይወት አኖረኝ፤ አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ ለእኔ ዛሬ ሰማንያ አምስት ዓመት ሆነኝ።

verses.en: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Mosheh sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
verses.am: ሙሴም በላከኝ ጊዜ እንደ ነበርሁ፥ ዛሬ ጕልበታም ነኝ፤ ጕልበቴም በዚያን ጊዜ እንደ ነበረ፥ እንዲሁ ዛሬ ለመዋጋት ለመውጣትም ለመግባትም ጉልበቴ ያው ነው።

verses.en: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof YAHUAH spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be YAHUAH will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as YAHUAH said.
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ በዚያን ቀን እግዚአብሔር የተናገረውን ይህን ተራራማ አገር ስጠኝ፤ አንተ በዚያ ቀን ዔናቃውያን ታላላቆችና የተመሸጉ ከተሞችም በዚያ እንዳሉ ሰምተህ ነበር፤ ምናልባት እግዚአብሔር ከእኔ ጋር ይሆናል፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረኝ አሳድዳቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And Yahoshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ባረከው፤ ለዮፎኒም ልጅ ለካሌብ ኬብሮንን ርስት አድርጎ ሰጠው።

verses.en: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed YAHUAH of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ስለዚህም የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ፈጽሞ ስለ ተከተለ ኬብሮን እስከ ዛሬ ለቄኔዛዊው ለዮፎኒ ልጅ ለካሌብ ርስት ሆነች።

verses.en: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.
verses.am: የኬብሮንም ስም አስቀድሞ ቂርያትአርባቅ ትባል ነበር፤ ይህም አርባቅ በዔናቅ ሰዎች መካከል ከሁሉ ከፍ ያለ ነበረ። ምድሪቱም ከውጊያ ዐረፈች። a

verses.en: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Yehudah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.
verses.am: ለይሁዳም ልጆች ነገድ በየወገናቸው እስከ ጺን ምድረ በዳ እስከ ደቡብ መጨረሻ እስከ ኤዶምያስ ዳርቻ ድረስ ዕጣ ሆነላቸው።

verses.en: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
verses.am: በደቡብም በኩል ያለው ድንበራቸው እስከ ጨው ባሕር መጨረሻ ወደ ደቡብ እስከሚያይ እስከ ባሕር ልሳን ነበረ።

verses.en: And it went out to the south side to Maalehacrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadeshbarnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
verses.am: ከዚያም በአቅረቢም ዐቀበት በደቡብ በኩል ወጣ፥ ወደ ጺንም አለፈ፥ በቃዴስ በርኔ ወደ ደቡብ በኩል ወጣ፥ በሐጽሮንም በኩል አለፈ፥ ወደ አዳርም ወጣ፥

verses.en: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Mitsrayim; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
verses.am: ወደ ቀርቃ ዞረ፥ ወደ አጽሞንም አለፈ፥ በግብፅም ወንዝ በኩል ወጣ፥ የድንበሩም መውጫ በባሕሩ አጠገብ ነበረ፤ በደቡብ በኩል ያለው ድንበራቸው ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
verses.am: በምሥራቅም በኩል ያለው ድንበር እስከ ጨው ባሕር እስከ ዮርዳኖስም መጨረሻ ነበረ። በሰሜንም በኩል ያለው ድንበር በዮርዳኖስ መጨረሻ እስካለው እስከ ባሕሩ ልሳን ድረስ ነበረ፤

verses.en: And the border went up to Bethhogla, and passed along by the north of Betharabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
verses.am: ከዚያም ድንበሩ ወደ ቤትሖግላ ወጣ፥ በቤትዓረባ በሰሜን በኩል አለፈ፥ ወደ ሮቤልም ልጅ ወደ ቦሀን ድንጋይ ወጣ፤

verses.en: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of Enshemesh, and the goings out thereof were at Enrogel:
verses.am: ድንበሩም ከአኮር ሸለቆ ወደ ዳቤር ወጣ፥ በሰሜን በኩል በአዱሚም ዐቀበት ፊት ለፊት፥ በወንዙ በደቡብ በኩል ወዳለችው ወደ ጌልገላ ተመለከተ፤ ድንበሩም ወደ ቤት ሳሚስ ውኃ አለፈ፥ መውጫውም በዓይንሮጌል አጠገብ ነበረ፤

verses.en: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Yerushalayim: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
verses.am: ድንበሩም በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ አጠገብ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደምትባለው ወደ ኢያቡሳዊው ወደ ደቡብ ወገን ወጣ፤ ድንበሩም በራፋይም ሸለቆ ዳር በሰሜን በኩል ባለው በሄኖም ሸለቆ ፊት ለፊት በምዕራብ ወገን ወዳለው ተራራ ራስ ላይ ወጣ፤

verses.en: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjathjearim:
verses.am: ድንበሩም ከተራራው ራስ ወደ ኔፍቶ ውኃ ምንጭ ደረሰ፥ ወደ ዔፍሮንም ተራራ ከተሞች ወጣ፤ ቂርያትይዓሪም ወደምትባል ወደ በኣላ ደረሰ።

verses.en: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
verses.am: ድንበሩም ከበኣላ በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ ሴይር ተራራ ዞረ፤ ክሳሎን ወደምትባል ወደ ይዓሪም ተራራ ወገን በሰሜን በኩል አለፈ፤ ወደ ቤትሳሚስ ወረደ፥ በተምና በኩልም አለፈ።

verses.en: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ አቃሮን ወደ ሰሜን ወገን ወጣ፤ ወደ ሽክሮን ደረሰ፤ ወደ በኣላ ተራራ አለፈ፥ በየብኒኤል በኩልም ወጣ፤ የድንበሩም መውጫ በባሕሩ አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Yehudah round about according to their families.
verses.am: በምዕራቡም በኩል ያለው ድንበር እስከ ታላቁ ባሕርና እስከ ዳርቻው ድረስ ነበረ። ለይሁዳ ልጆች በየወገናቸው በዙሪያው ያለ ድንበራቸው ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Yehudah, according to the commandment of YAHUAH to Yahoshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን እንዳዘዘው ለዮፎኒ ልጅ ለካሌብ በይሁዳ ልጆች መካከል ቂርያትአርባቅ የምትባለውን ከተማ ድርሻ አድርጎ ሰጠው፤ እርስዋም ኬብሮን ናት፥ ይህም አርባቅ የዔናቅ አባት ነበረ።

verses.en: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
verses.am: ካሌብም ሦስቱን የዔናቅን ልጆች ሴሲንና አኪመንን ተላሚንም ከዚያ አሳደደ።

verses.en: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher.
verses.am: ከዚያም በዳቤር ሰዎች ላይ ወጣ፤ የዳቤርም ስም አስቀድሞ ቂርያትሤፍር ትባል ነበር።

verses.en: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.am: ካሌብም። ቂርያትሤፍርን ለሚመታ ለሚይዛትም ልጄን ዓክሳን አጋባዋለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.am: የካሌብ ወንድም የቄኔዝ ልጅ ጎቶንያል ያዛት፤ ልጁንም ዓክሳን አጋባው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
verses.am: እርስዋም ወደ እርሱ በመጣች ጊዜ ከአባትዋ እርሻ እንዲለምን መከረችው፤ እርስዋም ከአህያዋ ወረደች፤

verses.en: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
verses.am: ካሌብም። ምን ፈለግሽ? አላት። እርስዋም። በረከትን ስጠኝ፤ በደቡብ በኩል ያለውን ምድር ሰጥተኸኛልና አሁን ደግሞ የውኃውን ምንጭ ስጠኝ አለችው። እርሱም የላይኛውንና የታችኛውን ምንጭ ሰጣት።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Yehudah according to their families.
verses.am: በየወገኖቻቸውም የይሁዳ ልጆች ነገድ ርስት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Yehudah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
verses.am: በደቡብም በኩል በምድራቸው ዳርቻ አጠገብ እስከ ኤዶምያስ ድንበር ያሉት የይሁዳ ልጆች ነገድ ከተሞች እነዚህ ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
verses.am: ቀብስኤል፥ ዔዴር፥ ያጉር፥ ቂና፥

verses.en: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
verses.am: ዲሞና፥ ዓድዓዳ፥ ቃዴስ፥ ሐጾር፥ ዪትናን፥

verses.en: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,
verses.am: ቤትጳሌጥ፥ ሐጸርሹዓል፥ ቤርሳቤህ፥ ቢዝዮትያ፥

verses.en: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,
verses.am: ቤትጳሌጥ፥ ሐጸርሹዓል፥ ቤርሳቤህ፥ ቢዝዮትያ፥

verses.en: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
verses.am: ቤትጳሌጥ፥ ሐጸርሹዓል፥ ቤርሳቤህ፥ ቢዝዮትያ፥

verses.en: And Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Bethpalet,
verses.am: ኪሲል፥ ሔርማ፥ ጺቅላግ፥ ማድማና፥ ሳንሳና፥

verses.en: And Hazarshual, and Beersheba, and Bizjothjah,
verses.am: ኪሲል፥ ሔርማ፥ ጺቅላግ፥ ማድማና፥ ሳንሳና፥

verses.en: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,
verses.am: ልባዎት፥ ሺልሂም፥ ዓይን፥ ሪሞን፤ ሀያዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
verses.am: ዓይንገኒም፥ ታጱዋ፥ ዓይናም፥ የርሙት፥

verses.en: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
verses.am: ዓይንገኒም፥ ታጱዋ፥ ዓይናም፥ የርሙት፥

verses.en: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:
verses.am: ዓዶላም፥ ሰኰት፥ ዓዜቃ፥ ሽዓራይም፥ ዓዲታይም፥ ግዴራ፥ ግዴሮታይም፤ አሥራ አራት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
verses.am: ምጽጳ፥ ዮቅትኤል፥ ለኪሶ፥ ቦጽቃት፥

verses.en: And Zanoah, and Engannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
verses.am: ምጽጳ፥ ዮቅትኤል፥ ለኪሶ፥ ቦጽቃት፥

verses.en: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
verses.am: ንጺብ፥ ቅዒላ፥ አክዚብ፥ መሪሳ፤ ዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
verses.am: ንጺብ፥ ቅዒላ፥ አክዚብ፥ መሪሳ፤ ዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdalgad,
verses.am: ንጺብ፥ ቅዒላ፥ አክዚብ፥ መሪሳ፤ ዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
verses.am: አቃሮን ከተመሸጉና ካልተመሸጉ መንደሮችዋ ጋር፤

verses.en: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,
verses.am: ከአቃሮንም ጀምሮ እስከ ባሕር ድረስ በአዛጦን አጠገብ ያሉት ሁሉ ከመንደሮቻቸው ጋር።

verses.en: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
verses.am: አዛጦንና የተመሸጉና ያልተመሸጉ መንደሮችዋም፥ ጋዛና የተመሸጉ ያልተመሸጉም መንደሮችዋ፥ እስከ ግብፅ ወንዝና እስከ ታላቁ ባሕር ዳርቻ ድረስ።

verses.en: And Gederoth, Bethdagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
verses.am: በተራራማውም አገር ሳምር፥ የቲር፥

verses.en: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
verses.am: ሶኮ፥ ደና፥ ዳቤር የምትባለው ቂርያትሰና፥

verses.en: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
verses.am: አፌቃ፥ ሑምጣ፥ ኬብሮን የምትባል ቂርያትአርባቅ፥ ጺዖር፤ ዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
verses.am: አፌቃ፥ ሑምጣ፥ ኬብሮን የምትባል ቂርያትአርባቅ፥ ጺዖር፤ ዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
verses.am: አፌቃ፥ ሑምጣ፥ ኬብሮን የምትባል ቂርያትአርባቅ፥ ጺዖር፤ ዘጠኝ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
verses.am: ዮቅድዓም፥ ዛኖዋሕ፥ ቃይን፥ ጊብዓ፥ ተምና፤ አሥር ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Mitsrayim, and the great sea, and the border thereof:
verses.am: ዮቅድዓም፥ ዛኖዋሕ፥ ቃይን፥ ጊብዓ፥ ተምና፤ አሥር ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
verses.am: ቂርያትይዓሪም የምትባለው ቂርያትበኣል፥ ረባት፤ ሁለት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And Dannah, and Kirjathsannah, which is Debir,
verses.am: ቂርያትይዓሪም የምትባለው ቂርያትበኣል፥ ረባት፤ ሁለት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ ቤትዓረባ፥ ሚዲን፥ ስካካ፥

verses.en: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
verses.am: ኒብሻን፥ የጨው ከተማ፥ ዓይንጋዲ፤ ስድስት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም የተቀመጡትን ኢያቡሳውያንን ግን የይሁዳ ልጆች ሊያሳድዱአቸው አልተቻላቸውም፤ ኢያቡሳውያንም እስከ ዛሬ በይሁዳ ልጆች መካከል በኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ ተቀምጠዋል።

verses.en: And Janum, and Bethtappuah, and Aphekah,
And Humtah, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
Halhul, Bethzur, and Gedor,
And Maarath, and Bethanoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
In the wilderness, Betharabah, Middin, and Secacah,
And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and Engedi; six cities with their villages.
As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, the children of Yehudah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Yehudah at Yerushalayim unto this day.
And the lot of the children of Yoseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Bethel,
verses.am: የዮሴፍም ልጆች ዕጣ በኢያሪኮ አጠገብ በምሥራቁ በኩል ካለው ከዮርዳኖስ አንሥቶ በምድረ በዳውና በተራራማው በኩል ከኢያሪኮ ወደ ቤቴል ወጣ፤

verses.en: And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
verses.am: ከቤቴል ወደ ሎዛ ወጣ፥ በአርካውያንም ዳርቻ በኩል ወደ አጣሮት አለፈ፥

verses.en: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Bethhoron the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.
verses.am: ወደ ምዕራብም እስከ የፍሌጣውያን ዳርቻ እስከ ታችኛው ቤትሖሮን ዳርቻ እስከ ጌዝር ድረስ ወረደ፥ መውጫውም በባሕሩ አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.en: So the children of Yoseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
verses.am: የዮሴፍም ልጆች ምናሴና ኤፍሬም ርስታቸውን ወረሱ።

verses.en: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Atarothaddar, unto Bethhoron the upper;
verses.am: የኤፍሬምም ልጆች ድንበር በየወገኖቻቸው እንደዚህ ነበረ፤ በምሥራቅ በኩል የርስታቸው ድንበር አጣሮትአዳር እስከ ላይኛው ቤትሖሮን ድረስ ነበረ፤

verses.en: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanathshiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ምዕራብ ወደ ሚክምታት በሰሜን በኩል ወጣ፤ ድንበሩም ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደ ተአናትሴሎ ዞረ፥ ወደ ኢያኖክ በምሥራቅ በኩል አለፈ፥

verses.en: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
verses.am: ከኢያኖክም ወደ አጣሮትና ወደ ነዓራት ወረደ፤ ወደ ኢያሪኮም ደረሰ፥ ወደ ዮርዳኖስም ወጣ።

verses.en: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ከታጱዋ ወደ ምዕራብ እስከ ቃና ወንዝ ድረስ አለፈ፥ መውጫውም በባሕሩ አጠገብ ነበረ። የኤፍሬም ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
verses.am: ይኸውም በምናሴ ልጆች ርስት መካከል ለኤፍሬም ልጆች ከተለዩ ከተሞች ጋር፥ ከተሞች ሁሉ ከመንደሮቻቸው ጋር፥ ነው።

verses.en: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
verses.am: በጌዝርም የተቀመጡትን ከነዓናውያንን አላሳደዱአቸውም፥ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ከነዓናውያን በኤፍሬም መካከል ተቀምጠዋል፤ የጕልበት ግብርም ያስገብሩአቸው ነበር። a

verses.en: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Yoseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
verses.am: ለምናሴ ነገድ ዕጣ ይህ ነው፤ የዮሴፍ በኵር እርሱ ነውና። የምናሴም በኵር የገለዓድ አባት ማኪር ብርቱ ሰልፈኛ ስለ ነበረ ገለዓድንና ባሳንን ወረሰ።

verses.en: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Yoseph by their families.
verses.am: ዕጣውም ለቀሩት ለምናሴ ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው፥ ለአቢዔዝር ልጆች፥ ለኬሌግ ልጆች፥ ለአሥሪኤል ልጆች፥ ለሴኬም ልጆች፥ ለኦፌር ልጆች፥ ለሸሚዳ ልጆች ሆነ፤ የዮሴፍ ልጅ የምናሴ ወንዶች ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.am: ለምናሴ ልጅ፥ ለማኪር ልጅ፥ ለገለዓድ ልጅ፥ ለኦፌር ልጅ፥ ለሰለጰዓድ ግን ሴቶች ልጆች እንጂ ወንዶች ልጆች አልነበሩትም የሴቶች ልጆቹም ስም ማህለህ፥ ኑዓ፥ ዔግላ፥ ሚልካ፥ ቲርጻ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Yahoshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, YAHUAH commanded Mosheh to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of YAHUAH he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
verses.am: እነርሱም ወደ ካህኑ ወደ አልዓዛርና ወደ ነዌ ልጅ ወደ ኢያሱ ወደ አለቆችም ቀርበው። እግዚአብሔር በወንድሞቻችን መካከል ርስት እንዲሰጠን ሙሴን አዘዘ አሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዘዘ በአባታቸው ወንድሞች መካከል ርስት ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ካለው ከገለዓድና ከባሳን አገር ሌላ ለምናሴ አሥር ዕጣ ሆነ፤

verses.en: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.
verses.am: የምናሴ ሴቶች ልጆች በወንዶች ልጆች መካከል ርስት ተቀብለዋልና፤ የገለዓድም ምድር ለቀሩት ለምናሴ ልጆች ሆኖአልና።

verses.en: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of Entappuah.
verses.am: የምናሴም ድንበር ከአሴር ጀምሮ በሴኬም ፊት ልፊት እስካለው እስከ ሚክምታት ድረስ ነበረ፤ ድንበሩም በቀኝ በኩል ወደ ዓይንታጱዋ ሰዎች አለፈ።

verses.en: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;
verses.am: የታጱዋ ምድር ለምናሴ ነበረ፤ በምናሴ ዳርቻ ያለው ታጱዋ ግን ለኤፍሬም ልጆች ሆነ።

verses.en: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ቃና ወንዝ ከወንዙ በደቡብ ወገን ወረደ፤ በምናሴም ከተሞች መካከል የነበሩት እነዚህ ከተሞች ለኤፍሬም ሆኑ፤ የምናሴም ድንበር በወንዙ በኩል በሰሜን ወገን ነበረ፥ መውጫውም በባሕሩ አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.en: Southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.
verses.am: በደቡብ በኩል ያለው ለኤፍሬም ነበረ፥ በሰሜንም በኩል ያለው ለምናሴ ነበረ፥ ድንበሩም ባሕሩ ነበረ፤ በሰሜን በኩል ወደ አሴር፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል ወደ ይሳኮር ደረሰ።

verses.en: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Bethshean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.
verses.am: በይሳኮርና በአሴር መካከል ቤትሳንና መንደሮችዋ፥ ይብልዓምና መንደሮችዋ፥ ዶርና የመንደሮችዋ ሰዎች፥ ዓይንዶርና የመንደሮችዋ ሰዎች፥ ታዕናክና የመንደሮችዋ ሰዎች፥ መጊዶና የመንደሮችዋ ሰዎች፥ ሦስቱ ኮረብቶች ለምናሴ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.am: የምናሴ ልጆች ግን የእነዚህን ከተሞች ሰዎች ሊያሳድዱአቸው አልቻሉም፤ ነገር ግን ከነዓናውያን በዚያ አገር በመቀመጥ ጸኑ።

verses.en: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Yisra'el were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በጸኑ ጊዜ ከነዓናውያንን የጕልበት ግብር አስገበሩአቸው፥ ፈጽመውም አላሳደዱአቸውም።

verses.en: And the children of Yoseph spake unto Yahoshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as YAHUAH hath blessed me hitherto?
verses.am: የዮሴፍ ልጆች ኢያሱን። እኔ ብዙ ሕዝብ ስለ ሆንሁ እስከ አሁንም እግዚአብሔር ስለ ባረከኝ ለምን አንድ ክፍል አንድም ዕጣ ብቻ ርስት አድርገህ ሰጠኸኝ? አሉት።

verses.en: And Yahoshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.
verses.am: ኢያሱም። ብዙ ሕዝብስ ከሆንህ ተራራማውም የኤፍሬም አገር ጠብቦህ እንደ ሆነ ወደ ዱር ወጥተህ በፌርዛውያንና በራፋይም ምድር ለአንተ ስፍራ መንጥር አላቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Yoseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Bethshean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.
verses.am: የዮሴፍም ልጆች። ተራራማው አገር አይበቃንም፤ በሸለቆውም ውስጥ ለሚኖሩት፥ በቤትሳንና በመንደሮችዋ በኢይዝራኤልም ሸለቆ ለሚኖሩት ከነዓናውያን የብረት ሰረገሎች አላቸው አሉት።

verses.en: And Yahoshua spake unto the house of Yoseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:
verses.am: ኢያሱም የዮሴፍ ወገን ለሚሆኑ ለኤፍሬምና ለምናሴ። አንተ ብዙ ሕዝብ ነህ፥ ጽኑም ኃይል አለህ አንድ ዕጣ ብቻ አይሆንልህም፤

verses.en: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ተራራማው አገር ለአንተ ይሆናል፥ ዱር እንኳን ቢሆንም ትመነጥረዋለህ፥ ለአንተም ይሆናል፤ ለከነዓናውያንም የብረት ሰረገሎች ቢሆኑላቸው የበረቱም ቢሆኑ ታሳድዳቸዋለህ አላቸው።

verses.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Yisra'el assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በሴሎ ተሰበሰቡ፥ በዚያም የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ተከሉ፤ ምድሩም ጸጥ ብሎ ተገዛላቸው።

verses.en: And there remained among the children of Yisra'el seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ርስት ያልተካፈሉ ሰባት ነገድ ቀርተው ነበር።

verses.en: And Yahoshua said unto the children of Yisra'el, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which YAHUAH of your fathers hath given you?
verses.am: ኢያሱም የእስራኤልን ልጆች አላቸው። የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር የሰጣችሁን ምድር ትወርሱ ዘንድ እስከ መቼ ለመግባት ቸል ትላላችሁ?

verses.en: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.
verses.am: ከየነገዱ ሁሉ ሦስት ሦስት ሰዎች ምረጡ፥ እኔም እልካቸዋለሁ፤ ተነሥተውም አገሩን ይዞራሉ፥ እንደ ርስታቸውም መጠን ይጽፉታል፤ ወደ እኔም ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Yehudah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Yoseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.
verses.am: በሰባትም ክፍል ይከፍሉታል፤ ይሁዳ በደቡብ በኩል በዳርቻው ውስጥ ይቀመጣል፤ የዮሴፍ ወገኖች በሰሜን በኩል በዳርቻው ውስጥ ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.en: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before YAHUAH our YAHUAH.
verses.am: እናንተም ምድሩን በሰባት ክፍል ጻፉት፥ የጻፋችሁትንም ወዲህ አምጡልኝ፤ በአምላካችንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በዚህ ዕጣ አጣጥላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of YAHUAH is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH gave them.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር ክህነት ርስታቸው ነውና ለሌዋውያን በመካከላችሁ እድል ፈንታ የላቸውም፤ ጋድም ሮቤልም የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በምሥራቅ በኩል የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ የሰጣቸውን ርስታቸውን ተቀብለዋል።

verses.en: And the men arose, and went away: and Yahoshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before YAHUAH in Shiloh.
verses.am: ሰዎችም ተነሥተው ሄዱ፤ ኢያሱም ምድሩን ሊጽፉ የሄዱትን። ሂዱ፥ ምድሩንም ዞራችሁ ጻፉት፥ ወደ እኔም ተመለሱ፤ በዚህም በሴሎ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዕጣ አጣጥላችኋለሁ ብሎ አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Yahoshua to the host at Shiloh.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም ሄደው ምድሩን ዞሩ፥ እንደ ከተሞችም በሰባት ክፍል ከፈሉት፥ በመጽሐፍም ጻፉት፤ ኢያሱም ወደ ሰፈረበት ወደ ሴሎ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And Yahoshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before YAHUAH: and there Yahoshua divided the land unto the children of Yisra'el according to their divisions.
verses.am: ኢያሱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሴሎ ዕጣ አጣጣላቸው፤ በዚያም ኢያሱ ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንደ ክፍሎቻቸው ምድሩን ከፈለ።

verses.en: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Yehudah and the children of Yoseph.
verses.am: የብንያምም ልጆች ነገድ ዕጣ በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ፤ የዕጣቸውም ዳርቻ በይሁዳ ልጆችና በዮሴፍ ልጆች መካከል ወጣ።

verses.en: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Bethaven.
verses.am: በሰሜን በኩል ድንበራቸው ከዮርዳኖስ ጀመረ፤ ድንበሩም ወደ ኢያሪኮ ወደ ሰሜን ወገን ወጣ፥ ከዚያም በተራራማው አገር ወደ ምዕራብ ወጣ፥ መውጫውም በቤትአዌን ምድረ በዳ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ከዚያ በደቡብ በኩል ቤቴል ወደምትባል ወደ ሎዛ አለፈ፤ ድንበሩም በታችኛው ቤትሖሮን በደቡብ በኩል ባለው ተራራ ወደ አጣሮትአዳር ወረደ።

verses.en: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Bethhoron southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, a city of the children of Yehudah: this was the west quarter.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ምዕራብ ሄደ፥ በቤትሖሮንም ፊት ለፊት ካለው ተራራ ወደ ደቡብ ዞረ፤ መውጫውም ቂርያትይዓሪም በምትባል በይሁዳ ልጆች ከተማ በቂርያትበኣል ነበረ፤ ይህ የምዕራቡ ዳርቻ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjathjearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:
verses.am: የደቡብም ዳርቻ ከቂርያትይዓሪም መጨረሻ ነበረ፤ ድንበሩም በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ ነፍቶ ውኃ ምንጭ ወጣ።

verses.en: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to Enrogel,
verses.am: ድንበሩም በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ፊት ለፊት ወዳለው ተራራ መጨረሻ ወረደ፥ እርሱም በራፋይም ሸሰቆ በሰሜን በኩል ነው፤ ወደ ሄኖም ሸለቆ ወደ ኢያቡስ ዳር በደቡብ በኩል ወረደ፥ ወደ ዓይንሮጌልም ወረደ።

verses.en: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to Enshemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
verses.am: ወደ ሰሜንም አለፈ በቤትሳሚስ ምንጭ ላይ ወጣ፥ በአዱሚም ዐቀበት ፊት ለፊት ወዳለው ወደ ጌሊሎት ደረሰ፤ ወደ ሮቤልም ልጅ ወደ ቦሀን ድንጋይ ወረደ፤

verses.en: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:
verses.am: በሰሜንም ወገን ወደ ዓረባ አጠገብ አለፈ፥ ወደ ዓረባም ወረደ፤

verses.en: And the border passed along to the side of Bethhoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ቤትሖግላ ወደ ሰሜን ወገን አለፈ፤ መውጫውም በዮርዳኖስ መጨረሻ በደቡብ በኩል ባለው በጨው ባሕር ልሳን አጠገብ ነበረ፤ ይህ የደቡቡ ዳርቻ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.
verses.am: በምሥራቅም በኩል ድንበሩ ዮርዳኖስ ነበረ። ይህ በዙርያቸው ዳርቻ በየወገኖቻቸው የብንያም ልጆች ርስት ነበረ።

verses.en: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethhoglah, and the valley of Keziz,
verses.am: የብንያምም ልጆች ነገድ ከተሞች በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ኢያሪኮ፥ ቤትሖግላ፥ ዓመቀጺጽ፥

verses.en: And Betharabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,
verses.am: ቤትዓረባ፥ ዘማራይም፥ ቤቴል፥

verses.en: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,
verses.am: ገባዖን፥ ራማ፥ ብኤሮት፥

verses.en: And Chepharhaammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:
verses.am: ገባዖን፥ ራማ፥ ብኤሮት፥

verses.en: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,
verses.am: ምጽጳ፥ ከፊራ፥ አሞቂ፥

verses.en: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Yerushalayim, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Yehudah.
verses.am: ሁለተኛውም ዕጣ ለስምዖን ልጆች ነገድ በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ፤ ርስታቸውም በይሁዳ ልጆች ርስት መከከል ነበረ።

verses.en: And they had in their inheritance Beersheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,
verses.am: እነዚህም ርስታቸው ሆኑላቸው፤ ቤርሳቤህ፥ ሤባ፥ ሞላዳ፥

verses.en: And Hazarshual, and Balah, and Azem,
verses.am: ሐጸርሹዓል፥ ባላ፥ ዔጼም፥ ኤልቶላድ፥

verses.en: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
verses.am: ሐጸርሹዓል፥ ባላ፥ ዔጼም፥ ኤልቶላድ፥

verses.en: And Ziklag, and Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusah,
verses.am: በቱል፥ ሔርማ፥ ጺቅላግ፥ ቤትማርካቦት፥

verses.en: And Bethlebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
verses.am: ሐጸርሱሳ፥ ቤተ ለባኦት፥ ሻሩሔን፤ አሥራ ሦስት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው፤

verses.en: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
verses.am: ዓይን፥ ሪሞን፥ ዔቴር፥ አሻን፤ አራት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው፤

verses.en: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalathbeer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
verses.am: እስከ ባዕላትብኤርና እስከ ደቡቡ ራማት ድረስ በእነዚህ ከተሞች ዙሪያ ያሉ መንደሮች ሁሉ። የስምዖን ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: Out of the portion of the children of Yehudah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Yehudah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.
verses.am: ከይሁዳ ልጆች ክፍል የስምዖን ልጆች ርስት ሆነ፤ የይሁዳም ልጆች እድል ፈንታ ስለ በዛባቸው የስምዖን ልጆች በርስታቸው መካከል ወረሱ።

verses.en: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:
verses.am: ሦስተኛውም ዕጣ ለዛብሎን ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ፤ የርስታቸውም ድንበር ወደ ሣሪድ ደረሰ፤

verses.en: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ መርዓላ ወጣ፥ እስከ ደባሼትም ደረሰ፤ በዮቅንዓም ፊት ለፊት ወዳለው ወንዝ ደረሰ፤

verses.en: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chislothtabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,
verses.am: ከሣሪድም ወደ ፀሐይ መውጫ ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደ ኪስሎትታቦር ዳርቻ ዞረ፤

verses.en: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittahhepher, to Ittahkazin, and goeth out to Remmonmethoar to Neah;
verses.am: ወደ ዳብራትም ወጣ፥ ወደ ያፊዓም ደረሰ፤ ከዚያም በምሥራቅ በኩል ወደ ጋትሔፍርና ወደ ዒታቃጺን አለፈ፤ ወደ ሪምንና ወደ ኒዓ ወጣ።

verses.en: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthahel:
verses.am: ድንበሩም በሰሜን በኩል ወደ ሐናቶን ዞረ፥ መውጫውም በይፍታሕኤል ሸለቆ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
verses.am: ቀጣት፥ ነህላል፥ ሺምሮን፥ ይዳላ፥ ቤተ ልሔም፤ አሥራ ሁለት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.am: የዛብሎን ልጆች ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
verses.am: አራተኛውም ዕጣ ለይሳኮር ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ።

verses.en: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም ወደ ኢይዝራኤል፥

verses.en: And Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,
verses.am: ወደ ከስሎት፥ ወደ ሱነም፥ ወደ ሐፍራይም፥ ወደ ሺኦን፥ ወደ አናሐራት፥

verses.en: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
verses.am: ወደ ረቢት፥ ወደ ቂሶን፥ ወደ አቤጽ፥

verses.en: And Remeth, and Engannim, and Enhaddah, and Bethpazzez;
verses.am: ወደ ሬሜት፥ ወደ ዓይንጋኒም፥ ወደ ዓይንሐዳ፥ ወደ ቤትጳጼጽ ደረሰ፤

verses.en: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Bethshemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ታቦርና ወደ ሻሕጹማ፥ ወደ ቤትሳሚስ ደረሰ፥ የድንበራቸውም መውጫ ዮርዳኖስ ነበረ፤ አሥራ ስድስት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.am: የይሳኮር ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
verses.am: አምስተኛውም ዕጣ ለአሴር ልጆች ነገድ በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ።

verses.en: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም ሔልቃት፥ ሐሊ፥ ቤጤን፥ አዚፍ፥

verses.en: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath;
verses.am: አላሜሌክ፥ ዓምዓድ፥ ሚሽአል ነበረ፤ በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ ቀርሜሎስና ወደ ሺሖርሊብናት ደረሰ፤

verses.en: And turneth toward the sunrising to Bethdagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthahel toward the north side of Bethemek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,
verses.am: ወደ ፀሐይም መውጫ ወደ ቤትዳጎን ዞረ፥ ወደ ዛብሎንም ወደ ይፍታሕኤል ሸለቆ፥ በሰሜን በኩል ወደ ቤትዔሜቅና ወደ ንዒኤልም ደረሰ፤ በስተ ግራ በኩልም ወደ ካቡል ወጣ፤

verses.en: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;
verses.am: ከዚያም ወደ ዔብሮን፥ ወደ ረአብ፥ ወደ ሐሞን፥ ወደ ቃና እስከ ታላቁ ሲዶናም ደረሰ።

verses.en: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ራማ፥ ወደ ተመሸገውም ከተማ ወደ ጢሮስ ዞረ፤ ድንበሩም ወደ ሖሳ ዞረ፤ መውጫውም በአክዚብ በኩል ወደ ባሕሩ ነበረ፤

verses.en: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.
verses.am: ዑማ፥ አፌቅ፥ ረአብ ደግሞ ነበሩ፤ ሀያ ሁለት ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.am: የአሴር ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
verses.am: ስድስተኛውም ዕጣ ለንፍታሌም ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ።

verses.en: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:
verses.am: ድንበራቸውም ከሔሌፍ፥ ከጸዕነኒም ዛፍ፥ ከአዳሚኔቄብ፥ ከየብኒኤል እስከ ለቁም ድረስ ነበረ፤ መውጫውም በዮርዳኖስ ነበረ።

verses.en: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznothtabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Yehudah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.
verses.am: ድንበሩም ወደ ምዕራብ ወደ አዝኖትታቦር ዞረ፥ ከዚያም ወደ ሑቆቅ ወጣ፤ ከዚያም በደቡብ በኩል ወደ ዛብሎን፥ በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ አሴር፥ በዮርዳኖስም በፀሐይ መውጫ ወደ ይሁዳ ደረሰ።

verses.en: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,
verses.am: የተመሸጉትም ከተሞች እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ጺዲም፥ ጼር፥ ሐማት፥

verses.en: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,
verses.am: ረቃት፥ ኬኔሬት፥ አዳማ፥ ራማ፥ አሶር፥

verses.en: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and Enhazor,
verses.am: የንፍታሌም ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: And Iron, and Migdalel, Horem, and Bethanath, and Bethshemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
verses.am: የንፍታሌም ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.am: ሰባተኛውም ዕጣ ለዳን ልጆች ነገድ በየወገኖቻቸው ወጣ።

verses.en: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
verses.am: የርስታቸውም ዳርቻ ይህ ነበረ፤ ጾርዓ፥ ኤሽታኦል፥ ዒርሼሜሽ፥

verses.en: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Irshemesh,
verses.am: አቃሮን፥ ኢልተቄ፥ ገባቶን፥ ባዕላት፥

verses.en: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,
verses.am: አቃሮን፥ ኢልተቄ፥ ገባቶን፥ ባዕላት፥

verses.en: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,
verses.am: የዳንም ልጆች ዳርቻ አልበቃቸውም፤ የዳንም ልጆች ከሌሼም ጋር ሊዋጉ ወጡ፥ ያዙአትም፥ በሰይፍም ስለት መቱአት፥ ወረሱአትም፥ ተቀመጡባትም፤ ስምዋንም በአባታቸው በዳን ስም ዳን ብለው ጠሩአት።

verses.en: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,
verses.am: የዳንም ልጆች ዳርቻ አልበቃቸውም፤ የዳንም ልጆች ከሌሼም ጋር ሊዋጉ ወጡ፥ ያዙአትም፥ በሰይፍም ስለት መቱአት፥ ወረሱአትም፥ ተቀመጡባትም፤ ስምዋንም በአባታቸው በዳን ስም ዳን ብለው ጠሩአት።

verses.en: And Jehud, and Beneberak, and Gathrimmon,
verses.am: የዳን ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ከተሞችና መንደሮቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: And Mejarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.
verses.am: ምድሩንም ሁሉ በየድንበሩ ርስት እንዲሆን ከፍለው ከጨረሱ በኋላ፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ለነዌ ልጅ ለኢያሱ በመካከላቸው ርስት ሰጡት።

verses.en: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
verses.am: በኤፍሬም ተራራማ አገር ያለችውን ተምናሴራ የምትባለውን የፈለጋትን ከተማ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ሰጡት፤ ከተማም ሠርቶ ተቀመጠባት።

verses.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.am: ካህኑ አልዓዛር፥ የነዌም ልጅ ኢያሱ፥ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ነገዶች የአባቶች አለቆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሴሎ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አጠገብ በዕጣ የተካፈሉት ርስት ይህ ነው። ምድሪቱንም መካፈል ጨረሱ።

verses.en: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Yisra'el gave an inheritance to Yahoshua the son of Nun among them:
According to the word of YAHUAH they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.

These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Yahoshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Yisra'el, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before YAHUAH, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.
YAHUAH also spake unto Yahoshua, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ኢያሱን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak to the children of Yisra'el, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Mosheh:
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። ሳይወድድ ሳያውቅም ሰውን የገደለ ገዳይ እንዲሸሽባቸው በሙሴ እጅ የነገርኋችሁን መማፀኛ ከተሞችን ለዩ፤ ከደም ተበቃዩ መማፀኛ ይሆኑላችኋል።

verses.en: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። ሳይወድድ ሳያውቅም ሰውን የገደለ ገዳይ እንዲሸሽባቸው በሙሴ እጅ የነገርኋችሁን መማፀኛ ከተሞችን ለዩ፤ ከደም ተበቃዩ መማፀኛ ይሆኑላችኋል።

verses.en: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.
verses.am: ከእነዚህም ከተሞች ወደ አንዲቱ ይሸሻል፥ በከተማይቱም በር አደባባይ ቆሞ በከተማይቱ ሽማግሌዎች ጆሮ ነገሩን ይናገራል፤ እነርሱም ወደ ከተማይቱ ይቀበሉታል፥ የሚቀመጥበትም ስፍራ ይሰጡታል።

verses.en: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.
verses.am: ደም ተበቃዩ ቢያሳድደው፥ አስቀድሞ ሳይጠላው ባልንጀራውን በስሕተት ስለ ገደለው ነፍሰ ገዳዩን በእጁ አሳልፈው አይስጡት።

verses.en: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.
verses.am: በማኅበሩ ፊት ለፍርድ እስኪቆም ድረስ፥ በዚያም ወራት ያለው ታላቁ ካህን እስኪሞት ድረስ በዚያች ከተማ ይቀመጥ፤ ከዚያም ወዲያ ነፍሰ ገዳዩ ይመለሳል፥ ወደ ከተማውም ወደ ቤቱም ሸሽቶ ወደ ወጣባትም ከተማ ይገባል።

verses.en: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Yehudah.
verses.am: በንፍታሌም ባለው በተራራማው አገር በገሊላ ቃዴስን፥ በኤፍሬምም ባለው በተራራማው አገር ሴኬምን፥ በይሁዳም ባለው በተራራማው አገር ኬብሮን የምትባለውን ቂርያትአርባቅን ለዩ።

verses.en: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ከኢያሪኮ ወደ ምሥራቅ ከሮቤል ነገድ በምድረ በዳው በደልዳላው ስፍራ ቦሶርን፥ ከጋድም ነገድ በገለዓድ ራሞትን፥ ከምናሴም ነገድ በባሳን ጎላንን ለዩ።

verses.en: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Yisra'el, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.
verses.am: በማኅበሩ ፊት እስኪቆም ድረስ በደም ተበቃዩ እጅ እንዳይሞት ሳያውቅ ሰውን የገደለ ወደዚያ እንዲሸሽ፥ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ በመካከላቸውም ለሚቀመጥ መጻተኛ የተለዩ ከተሞች እነዚህ ናቸው። a

verses.en: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Yahoshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Yisra'el;
verses.am: የሌዋውያን አባቶች አለቆች ወደ ካህኑ ወደ አልዓዛር፥ ወደ ነዌም ልጅ ወደ ኢያሱ፥ ወደ እስራኤልም ልጆች ነገዶች አለቆች ቀረቡ፤

verses.en: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, YAHUAH commanded by the hand of Mosheh to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
verses.am: በከነዓን ምድር ባለችው በሴሎ። እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ የምንቀመጥባቸውን ከተሞች፥ ለከብቶቻችንም መሰምርያዎች ትሰጡን ዘንድ አዝዞአል ብለው ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of YAHUAH, these cities and their suburbs.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እንደ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ከርስታቸው እነዚህን ከተሞችና መሰምርያቸውን ለሌዋውያን ሰጡ።

verses.en: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Yehudah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
verses.am: ለቀዓትም ወገኖች ዕጣ ወጣ፤ ሌዋውያንም ለነበሩ ለካህኑ ለአሮን ልጆች ከይሁዳ ነገድ፥ ከስምዖንም ነገድ፥ ከብንያምም ነገድ አሥራ ሦስት ከተሞች በዕጣ ሆኑላቸው።

verses.en: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.am: ለቀሩትም ለቀዓት ልጆች ከኤፍሬም ነገድ፥ ከዳንም ነገድ፥ ከምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ አሥር ከተሞች በዕጣ ሆኑላቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.am: ለጌድሶንም ልጆች ከይሳኮር ነገድ፥ ከአሴርም ነገድ፥ ከንፍታሌምም ነገድ፥ በባሳንም ካለው ከምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ አሥራ ሦስት ከተሞች በዕጣ ሆኑላቸው።

verses.en: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.am: ለሜራሪም ልጆች በየወገኖቻቸው ከሮቤል ነገድ፥ ከጋድም ነገድ፥ ከዛብሎንም ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ከተሞች ሆኑላቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as YAHUAH commanded by the hand of Mosheh.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ የእስራኤል ልጆች እነዚህን ከተሞችና መሰምርያቸውን ለሌዋውያን በዕጣ ሰጡ።

verses.en: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Yehudah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,
verses.am: ከይሁዳም ልጆች ነገድ ከስምዖንም ልጆች ነገድ በስማቸው የተጠሩትን እነዚህን ከተሞች ሰጡ።

verses.en: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.
verses.am: የፊተኛው ዕጣ ለእነርሱ ስለ ወጣ የሌዊ ልጆች የቀዓት ወገን ለሆኑ ለአሮን ልጆች ሆኑ።

verses.en: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Yehudah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ተራራማ አገር ያለችውን ቂርያትአርባቅ የምትባለውን ከተማ በዙሪያዋም ያለውን መሰምርያ ሰጡአቸው፤ እርስዋም ኬብሮን ናት፥ ይህም አርባቅ የዔናቅ አባት ነበረ።

verses.en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
verses.am: የከተማይቱን እርሻ ግን መንደሮችዋንም ለዮፎኔ ልጅ ለካሌብ ርስት አድርገው ሰጡት።

verses.en: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,
verses.am: ለካህኑም ለአሮን ልጆች እነዚህን ሰጡ፤ ለነፍሰ ገዳይ መማፀኛ ከተማ የሆነችውን ኬብሮንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ልብናንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,
verses.am: የቲርንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ኤሽትሞዓንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,
verses.am: ሖሎንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዳቤርንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
verses.am: ዓይንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዮጣንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ቤትሳሚስንና መሰምርያዋን፤ ከእነዚህ ከሁለቱ ነገዶች ዘጠኝ ከተሞችን ሰጡ።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,
verses.am: ከብንያምም ነገድ ገባዖንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ናሲብንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.am: አናቶትንና መሰምርያዋን፥ አልሞንንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራት ከተሞችን ሰጡ።

verses.en: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.am: የአሮን ልጆች የካህናት ከተሞች ከመሰምርያቸው ጋር አሥራ ሦስት ናቸው።

verses.en: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.am: ለቀሩትም ለቀዓት ልጆች ወገኖች ሌዋውያን የዕጣቸው ከተሞች ከኤፍሬም ነገድ ደረሱአቸው።

verses.en: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.am: በኤፍሬም ተራራማ አገር ለነፍሰ ገዳይ መማፀኛ ከተማ የሆነችውን ሴኬምንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ጌዝርንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.am: ቂብጻይምንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ቤትሖሮንንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,
verses.am: ከዳንም ነገድ ኤልተቄንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ገባቶንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ኤሎንንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gathrimmon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.am: ጋትሪሞንንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs; two cities.
verses.am: ከምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ታዕናክንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ጋትሪሞንንና መሰምርያዋን፤ ሁለቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.
verses.am: የቀሩት የቀዓት ልጆች ወገኖች ከተሞች ሁሉ ከመሰምርያቸው ጋር አሥር ናቸው።

verses.en: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beeshterah with her suburbs; two cities.
verses.am: ለሌዋውያንም ወገኖች ለጌድሶን ልጆች ከምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ ለነፍሰ ገዳይ መማፀኛ ከተማ በባሳን ውስጥ የሆነችውን ጎላንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ በኤሽትራንና መሰምርያዋን፤ ሁለቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,
verses.am: ከይሳኮርም ነገድ ቂሶንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዳብራትንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Jarmuth with her suburbs, Engannim with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.am: የርሙትንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዓይንጋኒምንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.am: ከአሴርም ነገድ ሚሽአልንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዓብዶንንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.am: ሔልቃትንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ረአብንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammothdor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.
verses.am: ከንፍታሌምም ነገድ ለነፍሰ ገዳይ መማፀኛ ከተማ የሆነችውን በገሊላ ውስጥ ቃዴስንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ሐሞትዶርንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ቀርታንንና መሰምርያዋን፤ ሦስቱን ከተሞች ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.am: የጌድሶን ልጆች ከተሞች ሁሉ በየወገኖቻቸው አሥራ ሦስት ከተሞች ከመሰምርያቸው ጋር ናቸው።

verses.en: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
verses.am: ከሌዋውያንም ለቀሩት ለሜራሪ ልጆች ወገን ከዛብሎን ነገድ ዮቅንዓምንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.am: ቀርታንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዲሞናንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ነህላልንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡ።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,
verses.am: ከሮቤልም ነገድ ቦሶርንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ያሀጽንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.am: ቅዴሞትንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ሜፍዓትንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡ።

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.am: ከጋድም ነገድ ለነፍሰ ገዳይ መማፀኛ ከተማ የሆነችውን በገለዓድ ውስጥ ራሞትንና መሰምርያዋን፥ መሃናይምንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.
verses.am: ሐሴቦንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ኢያዜርንና መሰምርያዋን፤ አራቱን ከተሞች ሰጡ።

verses.en: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.
verses.am: ከሌዋውያን ወገኖች የቀሩት የሜራሪ ልጆች ከተሞች ሁሉ በየወገኖቻቸው እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ዕጣቸውም አሥራ ሁለት ከተማ ነበረ።

verses.en: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Yisra'el were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ልጆች ርስት መካከል የነበሩት የሌዋውያን ከተሞች ሁሉ አርባ ስምንት ከተሞችና መሰምርያቸው ነበሩ።

verses.en: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.
verses.am: እነዚህም ከተሞች እያንዳንዳቸው ከመሰምርያቸው ጋር ነበሩ፤ እነዚህም ከተሞች ሁሉ እንዲሁ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH gave unto Yisra'el all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ለአባቶቻቸው የማለላቸውን ምድር ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ሰጠ፤ ወረሱአትም፥ ተቀመጡባትም።

verses.en: And YAHUAH gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; YAHUAH delivered all their enemies into their hand.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለአባቶቻቸው እንደ ማለላቸው በዙሪያቸው ካሉት አሳረፋቸው፤ ከጠላቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ይቋቋማቸው ዘንድ ማንም ሰው አልቻለም፤ እግዚአብሔርም ጠላቶቻቸውን ሁሉ በእጃቸው አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: There failed not ought of any good thing which YAHUAH had spoken unto the house of Yisra'el; all came to pass.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለእስራኤል ቤት ከተናገረው መልካም ነገር ሁሉ ተፈጸመ እንጂ ምንም አልቀረም።

verses.en: Then Yahoshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ኢያሱ የሮቤልን ልጆችና የጋድን ልጆች የምናሴንም ነገድ እኩሌታ ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው።

verses.en: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ ያዘዛችሁን ሁሉ ጠብቃችኋል፥ እኔም ላዘዝኋችሁ ነገር ሁሉ ታዝዛችኋል፤

verses.en: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of YAHUAH your YAHUAH.
verses.am: ይህንም ያህል ብዙ ጊዜ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ወንድሞቻችሁን አልተዋችሁም፥ የአምላካችሁንም የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ጠብቃችኋል።

verses.en: And now YAHUAH your YAHUAH hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH gave you on the other side Jordan.
verses.am: አሁንም አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገራቸው ወንድሞቻችሁን አሳርፎአቸዋል፤ አሁን እንግዲህ ተመለሱ፥ ወደ ቤታችሁና የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ወደ ሰጣችሁ ወደ ርስታችሁ ምድር ሂዱ።

verses.en: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH charged you, to love YAHUAH your YAHUAH, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.am: ብቻ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ ያዘዛችሁን ትእዛዙንና ሕጉን ታደርጉ ዘንድ፥ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ትወድዱ ዘንድ፥ መንገዱንም ሁሉ ትሄዱ ዘንድ፥ ትእዛዙንም ትጠብቁ ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ትጠጉ ዘንድ፥ በፍጹምም ልባችሁ በፍጹምም ነፍሳችሁ ታመልኩ ዘንድ እጅግ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: So Yahoshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.
verses.am: ኢያሱም መረቃቸው፥ ሰደዳቸውም፤ ወደ ቤታቸውም ሄዱ።

verses.en: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Mosheh had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Yahoshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Yahoshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,
verses.am: ለምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ሙሴ በባሳን ውስጥ ርስት ሰጥቶአቸው ነበር፤ ለቀረው ለእኩሌታው ግን ኢያሱ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በምዕራብ ወገን በወንድሞቻቸው መካከል ርስት ሰጣቸው። ኢያሱም ወደ ቤታቸው በሰደዳቸው ጊዜ እንዲህ ብሎ መረቃቸው።

verses.en: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.
verses.am: በብዙ ብልጥግና በእጅግም ብዙ ከብት፥ በብርም፥ በወርቅም፥ በናስም፥ በብረትም፥ በእጅግም ብዙ ልብስ ወደ ቤታችሁ ተመለሱ፤ የጠላቶቻችሁንም ምርኮ ከወንድሞቻችሁ ጋር ተካፈሉ።

verses.en: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Yisra'el out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of YAHUAH by the hand of Mosheh.
verses.am: የሮቤልም ልጆች የጋድም ልጆች የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ሄዱ፤ በሙሴም እጅ በተሰጠ በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ወደ ተቀበሉአት ወደ ርስታቸው ወደ ገለዓድ ምድር ይገቡ ዘንድ በከነዓን ምድር ካለችው ከሴሎ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.
verses.am: በከነዓን ምድር ወዳለው ወደ ዮርዳኖስ አቅራቢያም በመጡ ጊዜ የሮቤል ልጆችና የጋድ ልጆች የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ በዚያ በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ ታላቅ መሠዊያ ሠሩ።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች። እነሆ፥ በከነዓን ምድር ዳርቻ በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ ባለው ግዛት፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ባሉበት ወገን፥ የሮቤል ልጆችና የጋድ ልጆች የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ መሠዊያ ሠርተዋል የሚል ወሬ ደረሰላቸው።

verses.en: And when the children of Yisra'el heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Yisra'el gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ወጥተው እነርሱን ሊዋጉ በሴሎ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በገለዓድ ምድር ወዳሉት ወደ ሮቤል ልጆችና ወደ ጋድ ልጆች ወደ ምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ የካህኑን የአልዓዛርን ልጅ ፊንሐስን ላኩ።

verses.en: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Yisra'el; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር አሥር አለቆች ነበሩ፥ ከእስራኤል ከየነገዱ ሁሉ አንድ አንድ የአባቶች ቤት አለቃ፤ እያንዳንዱም በእስራኤል አእላፋት መካከል የእየአባቶቻቸው ቤት አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,
verses.am: በገለዓድም ምድር ወዳሉት ወደ ሮቤል ልጆችና ወደ ጋድ ልጆች ወደ ምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ መጡ፥ እንዲህም ብለው ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.en: Thus saith the whole congregation of YAHUAH, What trespass is this that ye have committed against YAHUAH of Yisra'el, to turn away this day from following YAHUAH, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against YAHUAH?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ማኅበር ሁሉ የሚለው ይህ ነው። ይህ በእስራኤል አምላክ ላይ ያደረጋችሁት ኃጢአት ምንድር ነው? ዛሬ እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል ተመልሳችኋል፤ ዛሬም መሠዊያ በመሥራታችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ዐምፃችኋል።

verses.en: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of YAHUAH,
verses.am: እኛ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከእርሱ ያልነጻንበት የፌጎር ኃጢአት ጥቂት ነውን? በእግዚአብሔር ማኅበር ላይ መቅሰፍት ወረደ።

verses.en: But that ye must turn away this day from following YAHUAH? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against YAHUAH, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እናንተ ዛሬ እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል ትመለሳላችሁን? ዛሬ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ብታምፁ ነገ በእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ ላይ ይቈጣል።

verses.en: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of YAHUAH, wherein YAHUAH's tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against YAHUAH, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of YAHUAH our YAHUAH.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የርስታችሁ ምድር የረከሰ ቢመስላችሁ የእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ ወደሚቀመጥበት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ርስት ምድር አልፋችሁ በመካከላችን ውረሱ፤ ከአምላካችንም ከእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ሌላ ለእናንተ መሠዊያ በመሥራታችሁ በእግዚአብሔርና በእኛ ላይ አታምፁ።

verses.en: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Yisra'el? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.
verses.am: የዛራ ልጅ አካን እርም ነገር በመውሰድ ኃጢአትን ስለ ሠራ በእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ ላይ ቍጣ አልወረደምን? እርሱም በኃጢአቱ ብቻውን አልሞተም።

verses.en: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Yisra'el,
verses.am: የሮቤል ልጆችና የጋድ ልጆች የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ለእስራኤል አእላፋት አለቆች እንዲህ ብለው መለሱላቸው።

verses.en: YAHUAH of elohim, YAHUAH of elohim, he knoweth, and Yisra'el he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against YAHUAH, (save us not this day,)
verses.am: የአማልክት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር፥ የአማልክት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አውቆታል፥ እስራኤልም ያውቀዋል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ዐምፀንና ተላልፈን እንደ ሆነ ዛሬ አታድነን፤

verses.en: That we have built us an altar to turn from following YAHUAH, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let YAHUAH himself require it;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል እንድንመለስ፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህል ቍርባን እንድናሳርግበት፥ የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕት እንድናቀርብበት ብለን መሠዊያ ሠርተን እንደ ሆነ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ ራሱ ይበቀለን፤

verses.en: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with YAHUAH of Yisra'el?
verses.am: ይልቁንም ከልባችን ፍርሃት የተነሣ። በሚመጣው ዘመን ልጆቻችሁ ልጆቻችንን። ከእስራኤል አምላክ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ምን አላችሁ?

verses.en: For YAHUAH hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in YAHUAH: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing YAHUAH.
verses.am: እናንተ የሮቤልና የጋድ ልጆች፥ እግዚአብሔር በእኛና በእናንተ መካከል ዮርዳኖስን ድንበር አድርጎአልና በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ እድል ፈንታ የላችሁም ይሉአቸዋል ብለን ይህን አደረግን። በዚህም ልጆቻችሁ ልጆቻችንን እግዚአብሔርን ከመፍራት አስተዋቸዋል።

verses.en: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:
verses.am: ስለዚህም። መሠዊያ እንሥራ አልን፤ ነገር ግን ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ለሌላ መሥዋዕት አይደለም፤

verses.en: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of YAHUAH before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in YAHUAH.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእኛና በእናንተ መካከል ከእኛም በኋላ በትውልዳችንና በትውልዳችሁ መካከል በሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና በቍርባን በደኅንነትም መሥዋዕታችን እግዚአብሔርን እናመልክ ዘንድ፥ በሚመጣውም ዘመን ልጆቻችሁ ልጆቻችንን። በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ እድል ፈንታ የላችሁም እንዳይሉ ምስክር ይሆናል።

verses.en: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of YAHUAH, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.
verses.am: ስለዚህም አልን። በሚመጣው ዘመን ለእኛ ወይም ለትውልዳችን ይህን ሲሉ፥ እኛ። እነሆ፥ አባቶቻችን ያደረጉትን የእግዚአብሔርን መሠዊያ ምሳሌ እዩ፤ በእኛና በእናንተ መካከል ምስክር ነው እንጂ ስለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ስለ ሌላ መሥዋዕት አይደለም እንላለን።

verses.en: YAHUAH forbid that we should rebel against YAHUAH, and turn this day from following YAHUAH, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of YAHUAH our YAHUAH that is before his tabernacle.
verses.am: በማደሪያው ፊት ካለው ከአምላካችን ከእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ሌላ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ለእህል ቍርባን ለሌላ መሥዋዕትም የሚሆን መሠዊያን የሠራነው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ በማመፅ እግዚአብሔርንም ዛሬ መከተልን ለመተው በማለት እንደ ሆነ ይህ ከእኛ ይራቅ።

verses.en: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Yisra'el which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.
verses.am: ካህኑ ፊንሐስና የማኅበሩ አለቆች፥ ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት የእስራኤል አእላፋት አለቆች፥ የሮቤል ልጆችና የጋድ ልጆች የምናሴም ልጆች የተናገሩትን ቃል በሰሙ ጊዜ ነገሩ እጅግ ደስ አሰኛቸው።

verses.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that YAHUAH is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against YAHUAH: now ye have delivered the children of Yisra'el out of the hand of YAHUAH.
verses.am: የካህኑም የአልዓዛር ልጅ ፊንሐስ ለሮቤል ልጆችና ለጋድ ልጆች ለምናሴም ልጆች። ይህን መተላለፍ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ አላደረጋችሁምና እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችን እንዳለ ዛሬ እናውቃለን፤ አሁን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከእግዚአብሔር እጅ አድናችኋል አላቸው።

verses.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Yisra'el, and brought them word again.
verses.am: የካህኑም የአልዓዛር ልጅ ፊንሐስና አለቆቹ ከሮቤል ልጆችና ከጋድ ልጆች ዘንድ ከገለዓድ አገር ወደ ከነዓን አገር ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች ተመለሱ፥ ወሬም አመጡላቸው።

verses.en: And the thing pleased the children of Yisra'el; and the children of Yisra'el blessed YAHUAH, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.
verses.am: ነገሩም የእስራኤልን ልጆች ደስ አሰኘ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ፥ ከዚያም ወዲያ የሮቤል ልጆችና የጋድ ልጆች የተቀመጡባትን ምድር ያጠፉ ዘንድ ወጥተው እንዲወጉአቸው አልተናገሩም።

verses.en: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that YAHUAH is YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሮቤል ልጆችና የጋድ ልጆችም። እግዚአብሔር አምላክ እንደ ሆነ ይህ በመካከላችን ምስክር ነው ሲሉ መሠዊያውን ምስክር ብለው ጠሩት።

verses.en: And it came to pass a long time after that YAHUAH had given rest unto Yisra'el from all their enemies round about, that Yahoshua waxed old and stricken in age.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ብዙ ዘመን ከሆነ በኋላ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እስራኤልን በዙሪያቸው ካሉት ጠላቶቻቸው ሁሉ ካሳረፈ በኋላ፥ ኢያሱም በሸመገለ በዕድሜውም ባረጀ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: And Yahoshua called for all Yisra'el, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:
verses.am: ኢያሱ እስራኤልን ሁሉ ሽማግሌዎቻቸውንም አለቆቻቸውንም ፈራጆቻቸውንም ሹማምቶቻቸውንም ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው። እኔ ሸምግያለሁ፥ በዕድሜም አርጅቻለሁ፤

verses.en: And ye have seen all that YAHUAH your YAHUAH hath done unto all these nations because of you; for YAHUAH your YAHUAH is he that hath fought for you.
verses.am: እናንተም አምላካቸሁ እግዚአብሔር በእነዚህ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ስለ እናንተ ያደረገውን ሁሉ አይታችኋል፤ ስለ እናንተ የተዋጋ እርሱ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ ካጠፋኋቸው አሕዛብ ሁሉ ጋር ከዮርዳኖስ ጀምሮ በፀሐይ መግቢያ እስካለው እስከ ታላቁ ባሕር ድረስ ለነገዶቻችሁ ርስት እንዲሆኑ የቀሩትን እነዚህን አሕዛብ በዕጣ ከፈልሁላችሁ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH your YAHUAH, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as YAHUAH your YAHUAH hath promised unto you.
verses.am: አምላካችሁም እግዚአብሔር እርሱ ከፊታችሁ በብርቱ ይበትናቸዋል፥ ከፊታችሁም ያሳድዳቸዋል፤ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገራችሁም ምድራቸውን ትወርሳላችሁ።

verses.en: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Mosheh, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;
verses.am: ስለዚህም በሙሴ ሕግ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈውን ሁሉ ለመጠበቅና ለማድረግ በጣም በርቱ፥ ከእርሱም ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም ፈቀቅ አትበሉ።

verses.en: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their elohim, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:
verses.am: በእናንተ መካከል ወደ ቀሩት ወደ እነዚህ አሕዛብ አትግቡ፤ የአማልክቶቻቸውንም ስም አትጥሩ፥ አትማሉባቸውም፥ አታምልኩአቸውም፥ አትስገዱላቸውም፤

verses.en: But cleave unto YAHUAH your YAHUAH, as ye have done unto this day.
verses.am: እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እንዳደረጋችሁት ወደ አምላካችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተጠጉ እንጂ።

verses.en: For YAHUAH hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ታላላቆችንና ኃይለኞችን አሕዛብ ከፊታችሁ አስወጥቶአል፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ማንም ሊቋቋማችሁ አልቻለም።

verses.en: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for YAHUAH your YAHUAH, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.
verses.am: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገራችሁ ስለ እናንተ የሚዋጋ እርሱ ነውና ከእናንተ አንዱ ሰው ሺህ ሰውን ያሳድዳል።

verses.en: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love YAHUAH your YAHUAH.
verses.am: አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ትወድዱት ዘንድ ለራሳችሁ እጅግ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ተመልሳችሁ በመካከላችሁ ወደ ቀሩት ወደ እነዚህ አሕዛብ ብትጠጉ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ብትጋቡ፥ እናንተም ወደ እነርሱ እነርሱም ወደ እናንተ ብትደራረሱ፥

verses.en: Know for a certainty that YAHUAH your YAHUAH will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which YAHUAH your YAHUAH hath given you.
verses.am: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ከሰጣችሁ ከዚህች ከመልካሚቱ ምድር እስክትጠፉ ድረስ መውደቂያና ወጥመድ፥ በጎናችሁም መግረፊያ፥ በዓይናችሁም እሾህ ይሆኑባችኋል እንጂ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ እነዚህን አሕዛብ ከፊታችሁ እንዳያሳድዳቸው ፈጽማችሁ እወቁ።

verses.en: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which YAHUAH your YAHUAH spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ዛሬ የምድርን ሁሉ መንገድ እሄዳለሁ፤ እናንተም እግዚአብሔር ስለ እናንተ ከተናገረው ከመልካም ነገር ሁሉ አንድ ነገር እንዳልቀረ በልባችሁ ሁሉ በነፍሳችሁም ሁሉ እወቁ፤ ሁሉ ደርሶላችኋል፤ ከእርሱም አንድ ነገር አልቀረም።

verses.en: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which YAHUAH your YAHUAH promised you; so shall YAHUAH bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which YAHUAH your YAHUAH hath given you.
verses.am: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር የተናገረው መልካም ነገር ሁሉ እንደ ደረሰላችሁ፥ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ከሰጣችሁ ከዚህች ከመልካሚቱ ምድር እናንተን እስኪያጠፋችሁ ድረስ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሁ ክፉን ነገር ሁሉ ያመጣባችኋል።

verses.en: When ye have transgressed the covenant of YAHUAH your YAHUAH, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other elohim, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of YAHUAH be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.
verses.am: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዛችሁን ቃል ኪዳን ስታፈርሱ፥ ሄዳችሁም ሌሎችን አማልክት ስታመልኩ፥ ስትሰግዱላቸውም፥ በዚያ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ይነድድባችኋል፥ ከሰጣችሁም ከመልካሚቱ ምድር ፈጥናችሁ ትጠፋላችሁ።

verses.en: And Yahoshua gathered all the tribes of Yisra'el to Shechem, and called for the elders of Yisra'el, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኢያሱም የእስራኤልን ነገድ ሁሉ ወደ ሴኬም ሰበሰበ፥ የእስራኤልንም ሽማግሌዎች አለቆቻቸውንም ፈራጆቻቸውንም ሹማምቶቻቸውንም ጠራ። እነርሱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቆሙ።

verses.en: And Yahoshua said unto all the people, Thus saith YAHUAH of Yisra'el, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other elohim.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ እንዲህ አለ። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አባቶቻችሁ፥ የአብርሃምና የናኮር አባት ታራ፥ አስቀድመው በወንዝ ማዶ ተቀመጡ፤ ሌሎችንም አማልክት አመለኩ።

verses.en: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Yitschaq.
verses.am: አባታችሁንም አብርሃምን ከወንዝ ማዶ ወስጄ በከነዓን ምድር ሁሉ መራሁት፤ ዘሩንም አበዛሁ፥ ይስሐቅንም ሰጠሁት።

verses.en: And I gave unto Yitschaq Ya'aqob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Ya'aqob and his children went down into Mitsrayim.
verses.am: ለይስሐቅም ያዕቆብንና ዔሳውን ሰጠሁት፤ ለዔሳውም የሴይርን ተራራ ርስት አድርጌ ሰጠሁት፤ ያዕቆብም ልጆቹም ወደ ግብፅ ወረዱ።

verses.en: I sent Mosheh also and Aaron, and I plagued Mitsrayim, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
verses.am: ሙሴንና አሮንንም ላክሁ፥ በመካከላቸውም እንዳደረግሁ ግብፅን ቀሠፍሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ አወጣኋቸው።

verses.en: And I brought your fathers out of Mitsrayim: and ye came unto the sea; and the Mitsrim pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.
verses.am: አባቶቻችሁንም ከግብፅ አወጣኋቸው፥ ወደ ባሕሩም ደረሳችሁ፤ ግብፃውያንም አባቶቻችሁን በሰረገሎችና በፈረሰኞች እስከ ኤርትራ ባሕር ድረስ አባረሩአቸው።

verses.en: And when they cried unto YAHUAH, he put darkness between you and the Mitsrim, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Mitsrayim: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም በጮኹ ጊዜ በእናንተና በግብፃውያን መካከል ጨለማ አደረገ፥ ባሕሩንም መለሰባቸው፥ አሰጠማቸውም፤ ዓይኖቻችሁም በግብፅ ያደረግሁትን አዩ፤ በምድረ በዳም ብዙ ጊዜ ተቀመጣችሁ።
